why.title: Your network outgrew spreadsheets a long time ago
why.lead: Candidates live in one tool, openings in a spreadsheet, audits in email and royalties in accounting. Every report means re-keying data, and nobody sees the whole network.

pains.text: The same data typed into disconnected systems, again and again.

pains.title: Royalty issues found too late

platform.title: One system for the whole franchise lifecycle
platform.lead: Six modules, one record of your network. Every module can be operated by AI agents.

items.q: Do I need to buy Salesforce licenses?
a: No. FranFast includes Salesforce Platform licenses (Enterprise Edition).

Already on Salesforce? FranFast is also available as a managed package on AppExchange that installs on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud, Enterprise Edition or above, so you keep everything you have already built. {appexchange}FranFast for existing Salesforce customers{/appexchange}
From 2 weeks for one core module without data migration. Multi-module rollouts, data migration, larger teams and add-ons take longer.
Agentforce with Flex Credits, or Claude and other LLMs through MCP and CLI.

items.q: Does it connect to my POS?
a: Yes. FranFast can connect to most popular POS systems that offer an API. Toast is available as a ready-made add-on, and FranFast is an Official Toast Partner.

items.q: Is it only for large franchisors?
a: No. FranFast serves franchisors at every stage, from emerging brands to global networks.

addons.title: Add-Ons
addons.lead: Add-ons are optional tools that plug into FranFast so your network can do more: collect payments, sign agreements, hold video calls, analyze your data or connect the systems you already use. Choose only what you need today and add more as you grow.
addons.note: Some add-ons may require their own licensing.

partners.tableau: A visual analytics platform transforming how we use data to solve problems.
partners.claude: Connect Claude to FranFast through MCP so your team can ask questions, analyze network data and run tasks in plain language, with the same permissions and audit trail as Salesforce.
partners.docusign: Send and execute agreements using the world’s leading e-signature solution.
partners.stripe: A fully integrated suite of financial and payments products. Reduce costs, grow revenue, and run your business more efficiently on a fully integrated platform. Use Stripe to handle all of your payments-related needs, manage revenue operations, and launch (or invent) new business models.
partners.toast: A cloud-based restaurant management system that provides a comprehensive solution for restaurants, integrating point-of-sale (POS), online ordering, and payroll services.
partners.ringcentral: A cloud unified communications platform offering a complete solution for calls, video conferencing, messaging, and business collaboration.
partners.zoom: Easy and accessible high-quality video conferencing for multiple participants.
partners.verified-first: A reliable and comprehensive background screening platform for secure and efficient hiring.
partners.avast: A powerful antivirus engine and advanced protection against malware and online threats for comprehensive device security.
partners.shopify: An e-commerce platform that, with its technology and tools, enables businesses and professionals to easily launch an online store in a short time.
partners.ordercentral: A centralized system designed to streamline and automate the order management process for businesses, particularly in B2B and eCommerce contexts.
partners.chargent: A platform centralizing customer data within Salesforce and integrating payment processing to maximize revenue and outcomes.
partners.autopilot: One of the easiest and most intelligent solutions for easily automating your business processes.
partners.tuvis: A complete solution for reorienting corporate interactions efficiently, compliantly, and securely, offering fully integrated solutions for each industry.
partners.mirage: Advanced Computer Telephony Integration (CTI) solutions specifically designed for Salesforce.
partners.sightcall: A real-time visual collaboration platform enabling seamless video calls and virtual teamwork for improved interaction and efficient problem resolution.
partners.cirrus-insight: Enhanced productivity with email and CRM integration, allowing users to effectively manage and synchronize their sales communications and data.
partners.mogli: Accelerate growth, identify revenue loss, and increase conversion rates—enhance your digital engagement strategy with Mogli Business Messaging.
partners.workato: Enterprise integration and automation allowing for fast and simple connection of applications and systems, enhancing workflow productivity.
partners.jitterbit: A data integration and synchronization platform designed for efficient and secure connection of systems and applications.
partners.geopointe: A Salesforce mapping and geolocation tool for interactive data visualization and analysis on a map.
partners.conga: A document management and business process automation platform that enables efficient and productive document generation, signing, and administration.

pledge.title: Empowering our clients’ customers to achieve success
pledge.text: At Fast Cloud Consulting, we believe that businesses have a responsibility to give back to the communities they serve. That’s why we are proud to be part of the Pledge 1% movement, a global network of businesses and individuals committed to using their time, skills, and resources to make a positive impact on the world.
pledge.item_text: The Pledge 1% movement was founded by Yvon Chouinard, founder of Patagonia, and Marc Benioff, founder of Salesforce. It calls on businesses to pledge 1% of their time and 1% of their products or services to charitable causes.
